notes: Identity verified from supplied canonical text: matching title Pushing moral buttons: The interaction between personal force and intention in moral judgment; all six named authors; doi:10.1016/j.cognition.2009.02.001. Primary article-in-press manuscript in Cognition, with methods, results and references across eight pages; no source PDF supplied. Pagination is manuscript pagination. Only n_o assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Target matched using study identifier and substantive manipulation/test, not row order or numerical matching. The subjects section provides demographics for the overall three-condition study, not final counts for the two conditions in the target contrast.
